info.title: Statistics-Center API
info.description:
1. Login to receive a JWT
2. Add JWT to request header (Authorization: Bearer ) for all following requests.

post.summary: Login first to receive a Json Web Token (JWT).

get.summary: Get a list of available games. JWT has to be supplied in the request header (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>)

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Return games for a specific season. If empty, the current season will be used.

get.summary: Retrieve stats for a specific match ID. JWT has to be supplied in the request header (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>)
Retrieve events for a specific match ID. JWT has to be supplied in the request header (Authorization: Bearer <JWT>)

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Filter by event name (shot, pass, jump)

get.summary: Connect to a Websocket with your preferred Service
